title: Dialect Diversity in Text Summarization on Twitter

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating representational diversity in extractive text summarization by calculating the fraction of African-American English (AAE) posts versus White English (WHE) posts included in the generated summaries compared to the original dataset.

Measuring the representational balance in text summaries by computing the fraction of posts written by male versus female account users in the generated summaries compared to the source collections (using the Claritin and CrowdFlower datasets).
